title: Create task list endpoint
instruction: Write a FastAPI app with an in-memory list `items` and a GET endpoint at `/items` that returns the list. Start with two initial items: 'Learn Python' and 'Build API'.
starter_code:
from fastapi import FastAPI

app = FastAPI()
items = ["Learn Python", "Build API"]

# Your code here
test_suite:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_list_items_returns_200():
    client = TestClient(exercise.app)
    response = client.get("/items")
    assert response.status_code == 200

def test_list_items_has_items_key():
    client = TestClient(exercise.app)
    response = client.get("/items")
    data = response.json()
    assert "items" in data

def test_initial_items():
    client = TestClient(exercise.app)
    response = client.get("/items")
    data = response.json()
    assert data["items"] == ["Learn Python", "Build API"]

def test_returns_list_of_strings():
    client = TestClient(exercise.app)
    response = client.get("/items")
    data = response.json()
    assert isinstance(data["items"], list)
    for item in data["items"]:
        assert isinstance(item, str)

title: Add POST to create items
instruction: Extend the previous app by adding a POST endpoint at `/items` that accepts a JSON body with an `item` field and appends it to the list. Return the updated list with status 201.
starter_code:
from fastapi import FastAPI
from pydantic import BaseModel

app = FastAPI()
items = ["Learn Python", "Build API"]

class NewItem(BaseModel):
    item: str

# Add POST endpoint here
test_suite:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_post_returns_201():
    client = TestClient(exercise.app)
    response = client.post("/items", json={"item": "Test Task"})
    assert response.status_code == 201

def test_add_item_returns_updated_list():
    client = TestClient(exercise.app)
    response = client.post("/items", json={"item": "New Task"})
    data = response.json()
    assert "items" in data
    assert "New Task" in data["items"]

def test_add_item_includes_original_items():
    client = TestClient(exercise.app)
    response = client.post("/items", json={"item": "Third Task"})
    data = response.json()
    assert "Learn Python" in data["items"]
    assert "Build API" in data["items"]
    assert "Third Task" in data["items"]

def test_add_item_rejects_missing_item():
    client = TestClient(exercise.app)
    response = client.post("/items", json={})
    assert response.status_code == 422

title: Add DELETE endpoint
instruction: Extend the app with a DELETE endpoint at `/items/{index}` that removes an item by its list index. Return a 404 if the index is out of range.
starter_code:
from fastapi import FastAPI, HTTPException

app = FastAPI()
items = ["Learn Python", "Build API", "Deploy"]

# Add DELETE endpoint here
test_suite:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_delete_valid_index():
    client = TestClient(exercise.app)
    response = client.delete("/items/0")
    assert response.status_code == 200
    data = response.json()
    assert "removed" in data
    assert "items" in data
    assert len(data["items"]) == 2

def test_delete_invalid_index_404():
    client = TestClient(exercise.app)
    response = client.delete("/items/999")
    assert response.status_code == 404

def test_delete_negative_index_404():
    client = TestClient(exercise.app)
    response = client.delete("/items/-1")
    assert response.status_code == 404

def test_delete_all_items_sequentially():
    client = TestClient(exercise.app)
    assert client.delete("/items/0").status_code == 200
    assert client.delete("/items/0").status_code == 200
    r = client.delete("/items/0")
    assert r.status_code == 200
    assert len(r.json()["items"]) == 0
